title: Adapting to the audience: board, management, technical teams and clients

videos.script: Marina's finding has to reach four different rooms. {{rooms}} The board, which meets once a quarter and thinks in money and risk. Paulo, who runs operations and has to pick a lever. Sandra's team, who will check every definition. And Ligeiro, the carrier, a company outside Faro with its own contract. {{four}} The finding is the same in all four. Late first boxes, more than double the cancellations. {{same}} What changes is everything around it. The unit, the depth, the first sentence, and the thing you ask for. {{changes}} A board slide about the join between two tables is wasted. A technical review with no definitions is an argument waiting to happen. {{waste}} This lesson writes Faro's opening four times, and asks you to do the same for your own analysis. {{yours}}
